This course provides a comprehensive guide to using Manis AI, an "action engine" that performs complex tasks like web research, website building, and workflow automation rather than just generating text. The tutorial covers everything from basic prompting and third-party tool integrations to building full-stack applications with payment processing and utilizing the developer API.
